title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented campus study environments, spanning quiet, group, computer, sensory-friendly, indoor, and outdoor options.

cards.title: Milne Library
cards.subtitle: 37 University Dr.
cards.notes: Use the library for a study session with natural light, collaboration areas, and innovation spaces; check library access information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A renovated academic hub with varied study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes the renovated Milne Library as having collaboration and innovation spaces and lots of natural light.
cards.access_notes: Building access depends on current library hours and campus access policies.

cards.title: Milne Library Quiet Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Milne Library, first and third floors
cards.notes: Choose a designated quiet-study area when you need fewer interruptions; keep your materials contained and follow posted library expectations.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated quiet areas within the renovated library.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo's Milne Library project information lists two quiet study spaces on the first floor and two on the third floor.
cards.source_title: Naming Opportunities: Milne Library - SUNY Geneseo
cards.access_notes: Located in Milne Library; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Milne Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Milne Library, third floor
cards.notes: Reserve a library study room for a focused group session; informational QR codes outside rooms provide the reservation route.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for small-group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo states that students may reserve one of the library's 15 study rooms, with QR codes outside each room.
cards.source_title: How to Book a Room - SUNY Geneseo
cards.access_notes: Student reservation is required; use the QR code posted outside the desired room.

cards.title: College Union Study Room 134
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, first floor
cards.notes: Set up in Room 134 for a straightforward indoor work block; plan around the College Union's regular building hours.
cards.short_summary: A designated first-floor study room in the College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies Room 134 on the first floor of the College Union as a study room open during regular building hours.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular College Union building hours.

cards.title: Computer Project Area (CoPA)
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, Room 112
cards.notes: Use CoPA when your work needs a campus computer or printing; bring files in a format you can access on Mac or PC.
cards.short_summary: A computer lab with printing in the College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says the Computer Project Area in Room 112 has Mac and PC computers plus color and black-and-white network printers.
cards.access_notes: Located in the College Union; access is subject to building hours and available equipment.

cards.title: College Union Conference Room 324
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, third floor
cards.notes: Check the room card outside Room 324; when it is not reserved, use it for a small study session and leave it as found.
cards.short_summary: A conference room available for study when unreserved.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists Conference Room 324 among College Union rooms that may be used for studying when not reserved.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not reserved; verify the room card outside the door.

cards.title: College Union Conference Room 325
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, third floor
cards.notes: Check Room 325's posted reservation status before settling in; keep the conference setup intact for the next scheduled users.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor conference room usable between reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists Conference Room 325 among College Union rooms that may be used for studying when not reserved.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not reserved; verify the room card outside the door.

cards.title: Bailey Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Bailey Hall, 25 Brodie Dr.
cards.notes: Bring a charged device and work from the atrium seating; the college notes that this building also has research labs downstairs.
cards.short_summary: An atrium study setting in the social-sciences building.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says Bailey Hall's atrium has many study spaces and that research labs are downstairs.
cards.access_notes: Access is subject to Bailey Hall's current building hours.

cards.title: Erwin 14 Sensory/Study Room
cards.subtitle: Erwin Hall, Room 14
cards.notes: Use the low-lit, sensory-friendly room for quiet focus or a reset; schedule your visit during the stated weekday opening window.
cards.short_summary: A low-lit sensory-friendly room for study or decompression.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes Erwin 14 as a quiet, comfy, low-lit sensory-friendly study and wellness space open to all.
cards.source_title: Office of Accessibility Services - SUNY Geneseo
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:15 p.m., according to the Office of Accessibility Services.

cards.title: College Green
cards.subtitle: 37 Sturges Path
cards.notes: For an outdoor change of scene, work on the Green with a weather-ready setup; SUNY Geneseo notes campus-wide Wi-Fi there.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus space with campus-wide Wi-Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes College Green as an outdoor hub for getting work done and states that campus-wide Wi-Fi is available.
